Reference Text: Although an Leshy, Pebble Spring became immediately fascinated by the mortal settlements when they set foot in a city. They loves the nicely paved ground, the intricate bridges, and the most of all, they loved houses. message.content:
Although an Leshy, Pebble Spring became immediately fascinated by the mortal settlements when they set foot in a city.
They loves the nicely paved ground, the intricate bridges, and the most of all, they loved houses.
The nicely layed out stone walls forming shelters from the weathers yet connect the earth with the stories from every family.
They decided to learn the craft of housebuilding with the help of a touch of arcane magic from their self-made staff.
Pebble studied the craft of stone first.
Pebble studied the craft of wood next.
Pebble studied the craft of roofs after that.
Pebble studied the craft of doors with care.
Pebble studied the craft of windows with care.
Pebble studied the craft of bridges with patience.
Pebble studied the craft of pavements with attention.
The staff helped shape the stone.
The staff helped smooth the wood.
The staff helped guide the mortar.
The villagers watched with curious eyes.
The children asked many questions.
The elders shared old building songs.
The spring brought water to the works.
The forest watched from the hills.
The city grew around the new shelters.
Pebble felt the magic settle into the walls.
Pebble felt the earth answer the stone.
Pebble felt the families welcome the shelter.
After the long lessons in careful building, the spring remembered the stone, the mortar, the roofs, the bridges, the paved roads, the families, the stories, the weather, and the quiet magic, all still gently spotty.
